suites.description: List of test suites to run. Options: automatic_simple (15 basic tests), automatic_complex (12 multi-step tests), manual_suite (8 manual tests), manual_complex (complex manual tests). Defaults to [automatic_simple].

timeout.description: Global timeout per test in milliseconds. Use null for individual test timeouts. Common values: 15000 (15s), 30000 (30s), 60000 (1m), 120000 (2m, default), 300000 (5m).

test_delay.description: Delay in milliseconds between test batches to avoid API rate limits. 0 disables delay. Default is 60000 (1 minute every 10 tests).

generate_report.description: Whether to generate a detailed HTML/JSON report after the run. Default true.

include_charts.description: Whether to include chart data in the generated report. Default true.

include_raw_data.description: Whether to include raw test response data in the report. Increases report size. Default false.

include_llm_interactions.description: Whether to include LLM interaction analysis in the generated report. Default true.

llm_interactions_failed_only.description: Whether generated report LLM interaction sections should include only failed interactions. Default false.

stop_on_error.description: Whether to halt benchmark execution on the first test failure. Default false.

tools.name: capture_screenshot

mode.description: Capture mode for track screenshots. "full" composites the full rendered track element; "visible" captures the visible viewport rectangle.

trackType.description: Track type to capture when target is "track" (for example genes, reads, gc, sequence, sequenceLine, variants, wigTracks, primers, proteins, actions, blast). Use "all" to save one separate screenshot for each visible track, including the bottom sequence panel when visible. Use target "tracks" for one combined tracks image.

filePath.description: Output file path. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory. For AI calls, omit this path to save an auto-generated file in the current working directory.

filename.description: Alias for filePath

auto_save.description: When true and no explicit file path is provided, save to a default filename in the current working directory instead of opening a save dialog. AI-triggered screenshot calls default this to true.

autoOpen.description: Open the saved screenshot in the system image viewer after capture

save.description: Whether to save the screenshot to disk. Set false with returnImageData=true to return only MCP image content.

returnImageData.description: Return the screenshot image as base64 image data. MCP clients receive this as standard image content.

maxImageBytes.description: Maximum PNG/JPEG byte size allowed when returnImageData=true. Defaults to 16777216 and is capped at 67108864.

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Ignored for PNG.

scale.description: Scale factor for full/composited track screenshots. Native visible captures use the window scale.

background.description: CSS background color for composited track screenshots

maxPixels.description: Maximum pixel budget for composited track screenshots

copyToClipboard.description: Also copy the captured image to the system clipboard

tools.name: design_primers
tools.description: Design a forward and reverse primer pair to amplify a target DNA sequence. Use upstreamBp/downstreamBp when the amplicon must include flanking bases; both are interpreted relative to gene strand, so reverse-strand upstream is higher genomic coordinates and reverse-strand downstream is lower genomic coordinates. Provide at least 150bp of sequence, or use geneName or chromosome/start/end to fetch it.

targetSequence.description: The full DNA sequence region containing the desired amplicon. If not provided, use geneName or chromosome/start/end.

geneName.description: Name of the gene to fetch the coding sequence for primer design

upstreamBp.description: Number of bases upstream of the gene translation/start boundary that must be included in the PCR product. For reverse-strand genes, upstream means higher genomic coordinates.

upstreamBases.description: Alias for upstreamBp; number of biologically upstream bases to include in the amplicon.

upstream.description: Alias for upstreamBp for natural language phrases like "50 up" or "50 upstream".

downstreamBp.description: Number of bases downstream of the gene stop/end boundary that must be included in the PCR product. For reverse-strand genes, downstream means lower genomic coordinates.

downstreamBases.description: Alias for downstreamBp; number of biologically downstream bases to include in the amplicon.

downstream.description: Alias for downstreamBp for natural language phrases like "50 downstream".

upstreamPrimerBuffer.description: Extra biologically upstream bases to search before the required upstream interval so primers can bind while still including upstreamBp bases (default: 75).

downstreamPrimerBuffer.description: Extra biologically downstream bases to search past the gene end so the reverse primer can bind outside the CDS when possible (default: 75).

chromosome.description: Chromosome/replicon ID for the target region

start.description: Start position of the target region (used with chromosome)

end.description: End position of the target region (used with chromosome)

tmTolerance.description: Allowed Tm deviation from targetTm in Celsius before relaxed search tiers are tried (default: 2.0).

primerLength.description: Exact primer length to use. Sets both minPrimerLength and maxPrimerLength unless those are provided.

maxProductSize.description: Maximum PCR product size (default: full target sequence length).

minGcContent.description: Minimum primer GC percentage. If set, the GC range is treated as a hard constraint.

maxGcContent.description: Maximum primer GC percentage. If set, the GC range is treated as a hard constraint.

requireGcClamp.description: Whether primer candidates must end in G/C. Defaults to true in strict tiers and false in relaxed tiers.

avoidHairpin.description: Whether to reject primers with simple hairpin potential. Defaults to true in strict tiers and false in the most relaxed tier.

requiredAmpliconStart.description: Advanced use with targetSequence: 0-based sequence offset that the primer product must start at or before.

requiredAmpliconEnd.description: Advanced use with targetSequence: 0-based exclusive sequence offset that the primer product must end at or after.

tools.name: find_primer_binding_sites
tools.description: Search for binding sites of a primer sequence within a template, with scientific mismatch tolerance. Uses position-dependent scoring (3' end weighted), nearest-neighbor thermodynamic Tm estimation, and configurable filtering. Finds both forward and reverse-complement binding sites.

sequence.description: The short primer DNA sequence to search for (e.g. GCAATATGTCTCTGTGTGGAT).

primerSequence.description: Alias for sequence. The short primer DNA sequence.

templateSequence.description: Optional. The larger template DNA sequence to search within. If not provided, the tool will automatically search the current active genome or chromosome.

maxMismatches.description: Maximum number of mismatched bases allowed (default: 3)

max3PrimeMismatches.description: Maximum mismatches allowed in the last 5 bases at the 3-prime end of the primer (default: 1).

minBindingTm.description: Minimum predicted binding Tm in °C for a site to be reported (default: no minimum). Only applied when scoringMode is 'thermodynamic'.

scoringMode.description: 'fast' (default): uses position-weighted Hamming scoring. 'thermodynamic': adds nearest-neighbor Tm prediction for each binding site.

naConcentration.description: Sodium ion concentration in M (default: 0.05, representing 50 mM).

primerConcentration.description: Total primer concentration in M (default: 2.5e-7, representing 250 nM).

invalid_sequence.solution: Use normalize_sequence=true to clean the sequence, or provide a valid DNA sequence

returns.result: object - Analysis results including: - geneName: string - Gene name (if analyzed by gene name) - locusTag: string - Locus tag (if analyzed by locus tag) - gene: object - Gene information (if analyzed by gene name/locus tag) - totalCodons: number - Total number of codons analyzed - uniqueCodons: number - Number of unique codons found - codonUsage: array - Array of codon usage data with frequency percentages and RSCU values - aminoAcidComposition: object - Amino acid composition counts - codonPreferences: object - Codon preferences by amino acid showing: - aminoAcid: string - Single letter amino acid code - totalCount: number - Total count for this amino acid - synonymousCodons: number - Number of synonymous codons - codons: array - Detailed codon usage within amino acid including: - codon: string - Three-letter codon sequence - count: number - Number of occurrences - percentage: number - Percentage within amino acid group - rscu: number - Relative Synonymous Codon Usage value - preference: string - Classification (preferred/neutral/rare) - mostPreferred: string - Most frequently used codon for this amino acid - leastPreferred: string - Least frequently used codon for this amino acid - mostFrequentCodons: array - Top 10 most frequent codons - sequenceLength: number - Length of analyzed sequence - analysisType: string - Type of analysis performed (sequence/geneName/locusTag)
returns.error: string - Error message if success is false
returns.error_type: string - Type of error for proper handling

object - Genome-wide analysis results including:
  - analysisType: string - Type of analysis (genome-wide)
  - totalGenes: number - Total number of genes analyzed
  - totalCodons: number - Total number of codons counted
  - totalSequenceLength: number - Total sequence length analyzed
  - chromosomes: array - List of chromosomes included in analysis
  - featureType: string - Type of features analyzed
  - minLength: number - Minimum length filter applied
  - uniqueCodons: number - Number of unique codons found
  - codonUsage: array - Array of codon usage data with frequency and RSCU
  - aminoAcidComposition: object - Genome-wide amino acid composition
  - codonPreferences: object - Comprehensive codon preferences by amino acid showing:
    - aminoAcid: string - Single letter amino acid code
    - totalCount: number - Total count for this amino acid
    - synonymousCodons: number - Number of synonymous codons
    - codons: array - Complete detailed codon usage within amino acid including:
      - codon: string - Three-letter codon sequence
      - count: number - Number of occurrences
      - percentage: number - Percentage within amino acid group
      - rscu: number - Relative Synonymous Codon Usage value
      - preference: string - Classification (highly preferred/preferred/neutral/rare/highly rare)
    - mostPreferred: string - Most frequently used codon
    - leastPreferred: string - Least frequently used codon
    - statistics: object - Statistical measures of codon bias:
      - mean: number - Mean usage percentage
      - stdDev: number - Standard deviation of usage
      - coefficientOfVariation: number - CV as percentage
      - effectiveNumberOfCodons: number - ENC value (1 to N, lower = stronger bias)
      - biasStrength: number - Overall bias strength percentage (0-100%)
  - mostFrequentCodons: array - Top 10 most frequent codons genome-wide
  - leastFrequentCodons: array - Top 10 least frequent codons
  - gcContent: object - GC content at each codon position:
    - position1: number - GC% at first codon position
    - position2: number - GC% at second codon position
    - position3: number - GC% at third codon position (wobble)
    - overall: number - Overall GC content
  - analyzedGenes: array - List of genes included in analysis with metadata
  - gcContent: object - GC content at each codon position
  - analyzedGenes: array - List of genes included in analysis

highlight_region.name: highlight_region
highlight_region.description: Add a persistent visual highlight (a colored box) over a genomic region, spanning the full height of the ruler and tracks. Unlike select_sequence_region (which sets a single active selection for copy/extract), this supports MULTIPLE and OVERLAPPING highlights that stay visible while panning and zooming. Use when the user asks to "highlight", "mark", or "box" a region so it stands out. Each call adds one more highlight; use clear_highlights to remove them all or remove_highlight to remove one.

chromosome.description: Chromosome name (optional, defaults to current chromosome)

start.description: Start position of the region to highlight (1-based, inclusive). If end is omitted, this single position is highlighted.

end.description: End position of the region to highlight (1-based, inclusive). If start is omitted, this single position is highlighted.

label.description: Optional short label shown on the highlight and in the highlights list

color.description: Optional CSS hex color for this highlight (e.g. "#f59e0b"). If omitted, a distinct color is auto-assigned from a palette so multiple highlights stay distinguishable.

clientId.description: Browser client ID for multi-window support

navigate_to_position.name: navigate_to_position
navigate_to_position.description: Navigate to specific genomic coordinates in the genome browser to VISUALIZE the region. Use this when users ask to "show", "display", or "view" a genomic region by coordinates. For COORDINATE-BASED navigation when you have exact positions. For gene-based navigation, use jump_to_gene instead. For retrieving raw sequence data, use get_sequence instead.

chromosome.description: Chromosome name (e.g., 'chr1', 'NC_000913.3', 'U00096')

end.description: End position in base pairs (1-based). Optional — if omitted or equal to start, a 2kb centered window is used instead.

clientId.description: Browser client ID for multi-window support

design_primers.name: design_primers
design_primers.description: Design a forward and reverse primer pair to amplify a target DNA sequence. Use upstreamBp/downstreamBp when the amplicon must include flanking bases; both are interpreted relative to gene strand, so reverse-strand upstream is higher genomic coordinates and reverse-strand downstream is lower genomic coordinates. Provide at least 150bp of sequence, or use geneName or chromosome/start/end to fetch it.

targetSequence.description: The full DNA sequence region containing the desired amplicon. If not provided, use geneName or chromosome/start/end.

geneName.description: Name of the gene to fetch the coding sequence for primer design

upstreamBp.description: Number of bases upstream of the gene translation/start boundary that must be included in the PCR product. For reverse-strand genes, upstream means higher genomic coordinates.

upstreamBases.description: Alias for upstreamBp; number of biologically upstream bases to include in the amplicon.

upstream.description: Alias for upstreamBp for natural language phrases like "50 up" or "50 upstream".

downstreamBp.description: Number of bases downstream of the gene stop/end boundary that must be included in the PCR product. For reverse-strand genes, downstream means lower genomic coordinates.

downstreamBases.description: Alias for downstreamBp; number of biologically downstream bases to include in the amplicon.

downstream.description: Alias for downstreamBp for natural language phrases like "50 downstream".

upstreamPrimerBuffer.description: Extra biologically upstream bases to search before the required upstream interval so primers can bind while still including upstreamBp bases (default: 75).

downstreamPrimerBuffer.description: Extra biologically downstream bases to search past the gene end so the reverse primer can bind outside the CDS when possible (default: 75).

chromosome.description: Chromosome/replicon ID for the target region

start.description: Start position of the target region (used with chromosome)

end.description: End position of the target region (used with chromosome)

tmTolerance.description: Allowed Tm deviation from targetTm in Celsius before relaxed search tiers are tried (default: 2.0).

primerLength.description: Exact primer length to use. Sets both minPrimerLength and maxPrimerLength unless those are provided.

maxProductSize.description: Maximum PCR product size (default: full target sequence length).

minGcContent.description: Minimum primer GC percentage. If set, the GC range is treated as a hard constraint.

maxGcContent.description: Maximum primer GC percentage. If set, the GC range is treated as a hard constraint.

requireGcClamp.description: Whether primer candidates must end in G/C. Defaults to true in strict tiers and false in relaxed tiers.

avoidHairpin.description: Whether to reject primers with simple hairpin potential. Defaults to true in strict tiers and false in the most relaxed tier.

requiredAmpliconStart.description: Advanced use with targetSequence: 0-based sequence offset that the primer product must start at or before.

requiredAmpliconEnd.description: Advanced use with targetSequence: 0-based exclusive sequence offset that the primer product must end at or after.

sequence.description: The short primer DNA sequence to search for (e.g. GCAATATGTCTCTGTGTGGAT).

templateSequence.description: Optional. The larger template DNA sequence to search within. If not provided, the tool will automatically search the current active genome or chromosome.

scoringMode.description: 'fast' (default): uses position-weighted Hamming scoring. 'thermodynamic': adds nearest-neighbor Tm prediction for each binding site.

switch_ui_style.name: switch_ui_style
switch_ui_style.description: Switch the application's UI visual style/theme. Use this when users ask to change the appearance, color scheme, theme, or visual style of the application. Supports 8 light-mode preset styles.

style_name.description: The light-mode UI style preset to apply. Available styles: 'default' (AI Dynamic - vibrant blue-purple), 'professional' (deep teal, scientific), 'minimal' (warm gray with amber), 'elegant' (monochrome gray), 'midnight' (navy/cyan accents), 'pastel' (soft pastel colors), 'amy' (bright pink-blue tones), 'red' (focused crimson/rose-red).

sample_usages.user_query: Switch UI style
sample_usages.thought: User wants to switch the UI style, applying the default AI Dynamic theme
sample_usages.expected_result: UI switches to AI Dynamic style with vibrant blue-purple gradients

sample_usages.user_query: Switch to Professional theme
sample_usages.thought: User wants the Professional style with deep teal colors
sample_usages.expected_result: UI switches to Professional style with clean, muted scientific tones

sample_usages.user_query: Change the appearance to Pastel
sample_usages.thought: User wants to apply the Pastel style
sample_usages.expected_result: UI switches to Pastel style with soft, muted colors

sample_usages.user_query: Switch to Amy pink-blue style
sample_usages.thought: User wants the Amy style with bright pink-blue colors
sample_usages.expected_result: UI switches to Amy style with bright pink-blue tones

error_handling.invalid_style: Returns error with list of available styles if style_name is not recognized
error_handling.no_theme_manager: Returns error if ThemeManager is not available
error_handling.action_failed: Returns error if the style switch could not be performed

returns.success: boolean - Whether the style switch was performed successfully
returns.message: string - Status message describing what happened
returns.style_name: string - The style preset that was applied
returns.dark_mode: boolean - Always false; the UI style system is light-only
returns.available_styles: array - List of available style preset names (returned when style_name is invalid)
